name: 06 Welcome
subject: You're in! Your LAM Ambassador kit
content:
You're in!

Hi Chad,

Welcome to the LAM Ambassador Program. We're really glad to have you.

Here's everything you need:

  1. Your 6 free months code: LAM-TEST-0001. Open the LAM app and go through the onboarding. On the plan screen, tap Enter promo code, type your code exactly as written, dashes included, and tap Apply code. This code is just for you and works once, so please redeem it soon and don't share it.
  2. Your promo code for your audience: CHADTESTA4FD. Families enter it on the LAM paywall to get 20% off their first year on the yearly plan, or their first month on the monthly plan. Say it in your videos and add it to your captions.
  3. Your dashboard: log in with the details Everflow emailed you to see clicks, conversions and commissions, and set up your payouts so we can pay you. If you live outside the US, choose your local currency for payouts: if you choose US dollars, the payment provider takes an international transfer fee from each payout.
  4. Your kit folder: Open your LAM Ambassador kit. Content ideas, captions, disclosure examples, our logos, and a quick guide to redeeming your 6 free months.

Must-dos on every LAM post:

  • Start the caption with #ad (and turn on the paid partnership label if the platform has one). In videos, also say or show "ad" near the start.
  • Add this line to your caption: "Not medical advice. Check with your doctor."
  • Newsletters and blogs: put "Ad" or "Affiliate link" right next to the LAM mention or link in the issue or post, and include "Not medical advice. Check with your doctor." near it.

The kit covers the details, including Stories. Tag @littleangelmedical so we can cheer you on, and if you post on more than one platform, reply with your other handles.

Aim for your first video (or newsletter issue or blog post) in the next 2 or 3 weeks. We'll check in on day 7.

Any questions, just reply here.

The LAM Ambassador Program Team

name: 16 Monthly ambassador email
subject: What parents are watching this month
content:
What parents are watching this month

Hi Chad,

Here's what caught parents' attention in October, plus a few ways to make each idea your own with LAM.

What's working with parents this month:

  • The countdown skit. A "30 seconds to pack before we leave the hospital" bit with an absurd last beat did more than 2,000 times its creator's usual views, because every new parent knows the moment. Your version: a "sick season bag" countdown that ends with LAM on the phone, so the first sick night has a plan.
  • The "don't wake the baby" POV. The little one finally falls asleep, something threatens the peace, and it's handled in near silence, all in about 12 seconds. Your version: "POV: they finally fell asleep and a new cough starts", then a quiet LAM check that helps see whether it can likely wait until morning or needs a next step.
  • The deadpan caption loop. Five seconds of a straight-faced little one under a cheeky question, made to be rewatched. Your version: "who else googles every cough at 2am?" with LAM in the caption as the calmer way to check what looks off.

What parents are asking (great video prompts):

  • How do I tell if my baby is gagging or actually choking on finger foods?
  • My child has a very high fever and the tests came back negative. When should I worry?
  • Do I need to cook vegetables first for baby finger foods?

Share your own experience and point people to their pediatrician for medical answers. Writing a newsletter or blog? One of these questions makes a great short section or post, with your promo code next to it.

A few reminders: LAM helps spot when something looks off and guides the next step, and the parent always decides. Never show other baby monitor or app brands, and only film children whose parents have said yes. Want the app on screen? Here it is: LAM on the App Store.

Quick tip: keep it short. The ideas that spread most this month ran under 15 seconds with one line of text on screen, so people watched twice and sent them to a friend.

Thanks for helping more families feel calmer on sick nights. We love seeing what you make.

The LAM Ambassador Program Team
